utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. Just send me the updated list and timing, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — thanks. Send me the updated list and time, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just let me know if anything shifts with the repair drive, and I’ll bring the tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do, Gus — I’ll keep tracking the location and let you know right away if anything shifts with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still hearing that Leo’s in for it and can bring tools if needed. Want me to help line up timing or pass along anything else?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Nell — that’d help a lot. I’m still waiting on the final date, time, and repair list, and I’ll pass them along as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, please do — just help spread the word and point anyone interested my way. I’m lining up volunteers and could really use the extra reach.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’m a bit swamped, but I’ll spread the word and send folks your way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping the supplies list organized for the repair drive, so tell me what you still need and I’ll track it down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep an eye out for anything we’re still missing. Has the date or location changed at all?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let folks know about the repair drive right away. People around here usually show up when there’s a good cause.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll send the final list and timing as soon as they’re set, and we can keep it organized from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I can handle the practical bits quietly from my side.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still waiting on Eli to finalize the list and timing, then I can pass it along to everyone. Once that’s set, I’ll help keep the neighborhood in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — once Eli locks it in, please send me the date, time, and repair list so I can plan around it. Then I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like Mara’s got it moving well. If there’s a first batch to pick up or anything to drop off while I’m out, just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, and what repairs are needed for the drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’m pulling together the list and timing now. I’ll send the repair details so you’ve got everything you need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — I’ll send you the date, time, and repair list soon. You’ll spread the word once I do, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I can do that—send the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mara — could you set up the table near the front and bring the tools over there? That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll set up the table near the front and bring the tools over right away.
